```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr)
```

```{r}
endo_cluster <- readRDS("data/fixed_annotated_aux.seurat.rds")@meta.data


```

```{r}
tbl <- endo_cluster %>%
  dplyr::filter(Class =="Peritoneal endometriosis") %>%
  separate( Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates ,c("LA1","LA2"),sep ="\\|") %>%
  mutate(across(c(LA1,LA2),as.numeric),LA2=replace_na(LA2,0)) %>%
  mutate(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates = LA1+ LA2) %>%
  #dplyr::filter( !is.na(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates) ) %>%
  group_by(Master_Assigned_Cell_Type,Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates) %>%
  summarise(count=n()) %>%
  mutate(prop= count/sum(count)*100)


```

```{r}
  ggplot(tbl,aes(x=prop,y=Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates)) +
    geom_point() + 
    scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~Master_Assigned_Cell_Type)
```

```{r}
tbl <- endo_cluster %>%
  dplyr::filter(Class =="Peritoneal endometriosis") %>%
  separate( Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates ,c("LA1","LA2"),sep ="\\|") %>%
  mutate(across(c(LA1,LA2),as.numeric),LA2=replace_na(LA2,0)) %>%
  mutate(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates = LA1+ LA2) %>%
  #dplyr::filter( !is.na(Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates) ) %>%
  group_by(Master_Assigned_Cell_Type,Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates,SampleName) %>%
  summarise(count=n()) %>%
  left_join(endo_cluster %>% count(SampleName,name="s"), by="SampleName") %>%
  mutate( prop= count/s*100)
```

```{r}
  ggplot(tbl,aes(x=prop,y=Number_of_lymphoid_aggregates)) +
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se=FALSE) +
  stat_regline_equation(label.y = 32, aes(label = ..rr.label..))+
  scale_x_log10() +
  facet_wrap(~Master_Assigned_Cell_Type, scales = "free_x")
```
